(x,x)∉R

(x,x)∈R
(5,5)∉R
for all x∈Z
for all x∈Z
and (2,2)∈R
and (5,5)∈R
,

the relation is
irreflexive
irreflexive
both reflexive and irreflexive
reflexive
neither reflexive nor irreflexive
.
